# Donald Trump’s Approval Rating On Strongest Issue Hits All-Time Low

Published

Aug 30, 2026 at 06:00 AM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

President Donald Trump’s handling of immigration has fallen to its weakest position in an Economist/YouGov tracker, a striking reversal on the issue that powered his return to the White House.

Trump’s immigration approval fell to 40 percent in August, while 53 percent disapproved, leaving him 13 points underwater among U.S. adult citizens. [...] ## Trump’s Immigration Rating Has Reversed

The newest Economist/YouGov poll that measured this issue found 40 percent approving of Trump’s handling of immigration and 53 percent disapproving.

results.content: A new Economist/YouGov poll, released Aug. 11, found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump's job performance, down 3 percentage points from the previous week. This marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in YouGov tracking since returning to office in 2025.
